prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: desktop AI redesign concept bitmap for TALKPIK AI user app
Primary request: Create concept-01 for page 12-D-M1-submission-confirmation-modal, state modal-open. Use the provided local screenshot context as visual reference only: a Korean TOPIK 51 writing workspace is dimmed behind a centered submission confirmation modal. Preserve the state purpose: final submission review, cannot edit after submission, checklist, checkbox acknowledgement, cancel and submit decision.
Composition/framing: desktop 1280x900 edge-to-edge app UI screenshot only; no browser address bar, tabs, bookmarks bar, OS window title bar, device frame, or watermark. Keep a left app sidebar, dimmed writing workspace, and a centered modal around 640px wide. Modal hierarchy: calm icon, strong question title, summary rows for problem type / answer length / last save, irreversible submission notice, compact pre-submit checklist, acknowledgement checkbox, cancel + disabled/active Obsidian submit CTA.
Style/medium: polished high-fidelity SaaS/product UI mockup, Ant Design-friendly components, compact density, 8px radii for workspace controls, 12-16px only where modal surface needs emphasis.
Color palette: Mist/Snow/Fog neutral surfaces with Obsidian #09090b as the only primary CTA. Use restrained green only for completion/count signal and restrained amber/gray for warning context. No loud AI gradients, no colorful CTA set, no decorative orbs.
Typography: Cosmica-like modern sans, Korean interface text as visual direction only, no oversized marketing headline, no negative letter spacing.
Must preserve state signals: dimmed background context, centered modal, final submission cannot be edited after submit, checklist, acknowledgement checkbox, clear primary decision.
Avoid: browser chrome, OS frame, mobile layout, card drop-shadow abuse, saturated purple/blue gradients, chromatic primary buttons, workspace-wide 28-36px radius, decorative illustrations that reduce UX clarity.
